description: Queensland Housing Profiles is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Queensland Government, Department of Communities Housing and Digital Economy. The Queensland housing profiles are developed by the Queensland Government Statistician's Office, Queensland Treasury. The user is able to generate housing profiles using recent housing, demographic, social and economic data. Option to select Local Government, State Electoral District (SED) or Statistical Area Level 2 (SA2). Coverage is the states and territories; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as monthly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
